cards.title: Phase B — Kelly sizing replaces band sizing
cards.dates: Sep 8 (Tue) — Kelly-window start · window reads Oct 8
cards.gate: Ships Tue Sep 8 on the Sep 1 λ̂ refit (7 days old — within the biweekly envelope); the scheduled Sep 15 + Oct 1 refits land mid-window as system-under-test refreshes, not ad hoc changes
cards.note: Port oracle3 ModelInformedSizer semantics (Apache-2.0): edge = bucket-λ-adjusted premium, Kelly ≤ 0.15×bankroll, confidence-scaled. Replaces heuristic band multipliers; paper caps kept. Input (audited 2026-08-31): drafts/octagon-audit.md — MIT reference impl for executable-quote Kelly (edge vs ask, not midpoint), liquidity haircut, per-category concentration + drawdown gates; calibrate to Polymarket, don't copy Kalshi defaults. Ref (awesome-options audit 2026-09-01): Thorp (2006) 'Kelly Criterion in Blackjack, Sports Betting, and the Stock Market' — canonical binary-bet fractional-Kelly treatment; read before the Kelly ship (2026-09-08). Predicted impact (2026-09-01, calibration-based): +$5–25/day (+3–15% of ~$165/day window) — long-shot <0.20 band up-sized 3–6x (z=4.14 edge), 0.80+ favorite band → ~0 trades (significant −8.7pp), executable-quote edge ~1c/trade. FALSIFIABLE TARGETS: (1) long-shot band share of realized PnL rises 3–6x vs pre-Kelly 48d window; (2) 0.80+ band trades ≈ 0; (3) no increase in max drawdown. PULLED FORWARD 2026-09-05 (approved): ships Tue Sep 8 on the Sep 1 λ̂ refit (in-envelope); Sep 15 + Oct 1 refits land mid-window as scheduled system refreshes. COMPRESSED: build + review + user approval by Sep 8. Pre-Kelly clean baseline = Sep 4–8 (4 trading days) only. CAVEAT: the +$5–25/day predicted impact was scaled off a ~$165/day window that does NOT match realized data (≈ −$10/day pre-fix) — re-pre-register expected impact on the 4 clean baseline days before ship; window-end reads Oct 8.

PMA validation, LOW risk, shadow-lane first, flag-revertible); (2) fold the mcp-server confirmation-gate + SELL-reduces-by-min(order,pos)/no-position-SELL-adds-exposure semantics (MIT, concept-only, ~2–4h doc work) into the sidecar risk-gate spec. NOTHING ships before the Kelly window closes Oct 8 (precommit-mid-oct-kelly-gate). AUDIT INPUT (2026-09-08, user-queued post-Kelly; drafts/ccxt-audit.md): multi-venue quote data backbone = **ccxt** (MIT; Polymarket+Kalshi+Hyperliquid coverage verified 2026-09-08) — adopt for arb quote breadth + perp-funding/OHLCV feature lane; do NOT churn existing bespoke CLOB/data-api/Kalshi read lanes. AUDIT INPUT (2026-09-09, user-approved carding; drafts/poly-maker-audit.md): warproxxx/poly-maker (MIT, Python, 1.5k★, 111/111 tests) is a maker-only MM bot whose core is the INTRA-VENUE half of this card — a YES+NO pair merged back to collateral locks edge 1−p−q. Two borrows for the design window (Sep 15–30): (1) the CTF pair-merge primitive — mergePositions across EOA / Gnosis Safe / V2 DepositWallet via the gasless builder relayer, nonce-serialized, LIVE-VERIFIED on-chain (tx 0x4d2a2064) — gives zero-market-impact exits AND makes the Polymarket-only YES+NO≠1 leg buildable WITHOUT any Kalshi dependency, sidestepping the phase-kalshi1 keyless data wall (our sidecar already reads top-of-book keyless); (2) reward-band quoting (half-spread clamped into rewardsMaxSpread, per-ORDER min qualifying size, both legs bid so both sides score) as the maker counterfactual to our taker entries — see drafts/c200-taker-fee-measurement-2026-09-09.md (fee = C×rate×p(1−p); politics 0.04; maker rebate 25%). Port cost: read ≈½ day, dry-run port ≈ 2–3 days (cost is wallet-type signing + builder-relayer creds, not logic); ship as a manual CLI primitive first, flag-revertible. CAVEAT: the repo's own live session LOST $15.51 — the maker-lane strategy is an unproven hypothesis; the merge primitive is the part worth taking.

cards.note: Homelab hardware purchases unlock ONLY after production CopyBot proves ≥$500/day (7 consecutive days, C-200 advance rule). cards.note: REFERENCE from the HarrierOnChain audit (MIT, Rust, 3.4k LOC): when live capital unlocks, borrow structure from its execution engine — clob.rs (EIP-712 CTF order signing + L2 HMAC auth + POST /order, 489 LOC), order_executor.rs (FAK/GTD, dry-run path, 310 LOC), risk_guard.rs (circuit breaker + depth guard + per-category caps, 186 LOC), TP/SL midprice→FAK exit monitor. Sidecar (polyhydra-whale-signal) is signal-only today; this is the blueprint for the executor half. Do NOT adopt wholesale: (1) copy-trade ingestion is on-chain OrderFilled (misses off-chain CLOB fills — our data-api orderfilled sidecar source is correct, keep ours); (2) 9 of 10 strategies are 12–70 LOC stubs (README status column was deleted in the latest commit); (3) scaffold ideas (resolution-sniper, market_maker) contradict our favorite-band ≈0-trades findings. Compare their risk-guard semantics vs our RuleSet/exposure-cap engine before porting anything. FURTHER REFERENCE (2026-09-09; drafts/poly-maker-audit.md): warproxxx/poly-maker (MIT, Python) adds two things this card's Harrier read does not: (1) a CTF pair-merge executor — mergePositions via EOA / Gnosis Safe execTransaction / V2 DepositWallet through the gasless builder relayer, nonce-serialized, live-verified (tx 0x4d2a2064) — the zero-market-impact exit primitive; (2) run-tested safety patterns for live maker/quoter operation: chained heartbeat dead-man switch (3 consecutive misses → halt + resync → cancel-all within ~10s of the engine dying), ws-stale halt (10s) AND user-stream-blind halt (15s — pull every quote when you can't see your own fills), rolling order-error-rate breaker (≥20 order attempts, 25% threshold), daily-loss kill switch, 20s REST drift reconciliation, rate budget at 25% of documented limits. Adopt as design at go-live; re-derive constants for our stack.

cards.title: Paper-ledger fee fidelity — taker-fee model + maker/taker capture
cards.gate: Post-Oct-8 (Kelly window). Measurement-only so far — NO lane/rule/PnL change. Any wiring lands behind a rules flag, shadow column first (booked PnL untouched), revertible
cards.note: MEASURED 2026-09-09 (drafts/c200-taker-fee-measurement-2026-09-09.md): the paper ledger books fills with NO fee model. Applying Polymarket's official taker fee (C×feeRate×p(1−p); politics 0.04 / sports-other 0.05 / crypto 0.07 / geopolitics 0; maker 0, 25% rebate) to all 9,531 realized trades: gross +$5,397.60 → fee $2,464 → net +$2,934 (flat-0.04: fee $1,978). C-200 (BANKROLL_200) gross −$153.77 → net −$420 to −$481 — loss-making under every coefficient. ENTRY leg = 87% of the fee (we cross to enter). 238 trades (63 in C-200) flip winner→loser. NEXT: (1) emit fee-adjusted PnL as a SHADOW column beside booked PnL; (2) record maker/taker (or order type) on paper fills — without it the estimate is stuck at the all-taker bound; (3) feeds drafts/phase-c-design-notes.md (maker-entry counterfactual) and the Phase D2 realistic-fill work.

cards.title: v54 — Dead-zone (0.40–0.60) admission stop (APPROVED, queued for the Oct 8 window close)
cards.dates: Approved 2026-09-11 (C-200 daily report Change 2) · queued to Oct 8 by default (window-contamination caveat) · shadow evidence available from Sep 22
cards.gate: Pre-registered Kelly window (Sep 8–Oct 8) — applying now contaminates the window read; the report's own caveat. Apply on explicit user override ('apply dead-zone gate now') or at the Oct 8 close with the shadow-ladder evidence.
cards.note: WHY: 0.40–0.60 consumes 46% of all staked capital ($3,713) at −13.7% lifetime and −30.0% ROI in the last 7d; v51's ×0.25 cut shrank the absolute loss, not the bleed RATE (capital is not stuck — avg open age 17.6h, recycler frees it hourly — the bot re-enters ~18×/day by flow at 99% cap utilization), so every dead-zone admit displaces long-shot stake (~$76/day of stake redirected). FIX (admission-only): band-scoped gate in the admission path — copyScore ≥ 90 within [0.40,0.60) or zero admits; must cover the short-TTR LANE + legacy paths (Kelly main-lane already skips the band via λ̂=+0.03). Candidate implementation: new ruleset field(s) (deadZoneMinCopyScore / deadZoneAdmitEnabled) enforced in score-trades admission for all C-200 paths, fan-out-validated against the lane. VERIFY: 0 C-200 open copies with entry ∈ [0.40,0.60) 7d after apply; long-shot (<0.20) admits/day ≥ pre-apply; C-200 clean-regime ROI unchanged-or-better at the next review.

cards.title: Decision-level (deduped) stats as the published sample? — switch calibration + daily report off duplicate rows
cards.effort: ~1h (flag exists; the question is the default + a report re-baseline)
cards.gate: User decision, no date gate. Mid-window (to Oct 8) keep raw as the published default so window comparisons stay stable — the deduped view is the DECISION view, not the published one.
cards.note: FINDING: PaperTrade carries legacy duplicate accumulation rows (pre-guard multi-entry, same market+outcome). All-time C-200 finished Polymarket-only: raw N=1,473 vs decision-level N=785 (688 duplicate rows). Duplicates are pseudo-replication — they count one bet N times and inflate every z-stat. Direction survives, magnitudes do not: 24–72h exits raw -$1,215.72/1,069 rows vs deduped -$406.10/511 decisions; all-time realized raw -$137.06 vs deduped +$243.66. Significance FLIPS both ways: 08:00 ET z -2.69 -> -1.77 and 20:00 ET -2.82 -> -1.35 (lost), 0.40–0.60 band -2.26 -> -2.87 (gained, strengthens the queued dead-zone stop), 0.20–0.40 realized PnL -$214.45 -> +$132.69 (the 'positive edge yet negative realized' contradiction was a duplicate artifact). TOOLING: scripts/analyze-calibration.py now has opt-in --dedupe (writes calibration-analysis[-since-<date>]-deduped.json; default unchanged); scripts/analyze-change2-gates.py always dedupes. OPEN QUESTION: make dedupe the default for the daily report + calibrate-premium.py (re-baselines published numbers) or keep raw published + deduped as the decision view.
